items.headline: Monday.com to cut ~20% of global workforce (over 600 employees) as part of AI-focused restructuring plan
Monday.com lays off hundreds of employees, refocuses investments on AI Work Platform and leaner operating model
Monday.com cuts hundreds of jobs, expects $45–$55M restructuring charges and raises full-year 2026 non-GAAP operating margin outlook to 15%
Monday.com files Form 6-K detailing plan to cut 20% of workforce to align with strategic focus on AI Work Platform
